title: TarotReading
description: Specification for an immutable or updated record of a performed tarot reading: links to a spread template, holds drawn cards per slot, query context, and synthesis.

@context.title: JSON-LD Context URL
@context.description: Optional JSON-LD context URL for Schema.org semantic interoperability and graph expansion.

@type.title: Schema.org Type
@type.description: Schema.org entity type corresponding to a performed divination event or action.

schemaVersion.title: Specification Version
schemaVersion.description: Semantic version of the TarotReading schema specification.

readingId.title: Reading UUID Identifier
readingId.description: Unique UUID v4 identifier for this reading session.

spreadId.title: Spread Template Identifier
spreadId.description: Identifier of the spread definition used for this reading.

variantId.title: Variant Identifier
variantId.description: Optional reading variant identifier if a variant was selected.

question.title: Inquiry Question
question.description: The querent's question or focal inquiry topic formulating the reading.
examples: What energy should I cultivate for my upcoming creative venture?

querent.title: Querent Profile
querent.description: Information about the subject seeking insight.

name.title: Querent Name
name.description: Name or pseudonym of the querent.

significator.title: Significator Card
significator.description: Card ID chosen as querent significator.

reader.title: Reader Profile
reader.description: Information regarding the practitioner conducting the reading.

drawnAt.title: Draw Timestamp
drawnAt.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when cards were drawn.

startDate.title: Schema.org Start Date
startDate.description: Schema.org Event startDate mapping for drawnAt.

deck.title: Deck Metadata
deck.description: Information on the physical or digital tarot deck utilized.

name.title: Deck Name
name.description: Name or edition of the physical or digital deck used.

reversals.title: Reversals Active
reversals.description: Whether reversals were factored into this draw.

cards.title: Drawn Cards
cards.description: The cards drawn into the respective slots of the spread.

interpretation.title: Synthesis Interpretation
interpretation.description: Reader's synthesis of the overall card array.

summary.title: Summary
examples: Clear path forward once initial doubt is released.

elementalBalance.title: Elemental Balance
elementalBalance.description: Count of cards belonging to each elemental domain.

synthesis.title: Narrative Synthesis
examples: The Magician in past position provided mastery...

actionableAdvice.title: Actionable Advice
actionableAdvice.description: Concrete steps recommended for the querent.
examples: Prioritize clear documentation over premature optimization.

notes.title: Session Notes
notes.description: General practitioner or querent reflection notes.
examples: Reading conducted in morning light with breath meditation.

tags.title: Classification Tags
tags.description: Thematic tags for organizing reading archives.

drawnCard.title: DrawnCardRecord
drawnCard.description: Record of an individual card placed into a specific spread slot.

slotId.title: Slot Identifier
slotId.description: Matches the slot id in the corresponding spread definition.

notes.title: Card Positional Notes
notes.description: Specific interpretation notes for this card in this position.
